title: TAT-3953 advanced order types match Figma
description: Opens the Pro order form for BTC and proves the TWAP, Scale and Chase order types render the copy and summary rows from Figma section 12187:36456, including the TWAP Runtime and Size per suborder summary rows and the Runtime info affordance.

status.intent: Resolve the Mobile checkout and adapter status before the proof

cdp.intent: Confirm the React Native debug bridge is reachable

ensure-unlocked.intent: Ensure the wallet is unlocked before opening the Pro order form

open-market.intent: Open the BTC market view; the next node proves the Pro order form is the one on screen

await-order-form.intent: Confirm the Pro order form order-type control is on screen

open-order-type-sheet-twap.intent: Open the order type chooser to reach the Advanced tab

advanced-tab-twap.intent: Show the Advanced tab that lists TWAP, Scale and Chase

assert-twap-option-copy.text: Split orders to execute at regular time interval
assert-twap-option-copy.intent: Prove the TWAP description matches the Figma Advanced tab copy

assert-scale-option-copy.text: Multiple limit orders spread across a price range
assert-scale-option-copy.intent: Prove the Scale description matches the Figma Advanced tab copy

assert-chase-option-copy.text: Auto adjust limit order to the best price
assert-chase-option-copy.intent: Prove the Chase description matches the Figma Advanced tab copy

capture-order-type-sheet.label: Advanced tab listing TWAP, Scale and Chase with their Figma descriptions
capture-order-type-sheet.intent: Preserve the Advanced tab copy as reviewer evidence

select-twap.intent: Switch the order form to the TWAP order type

assert-twap-runtime-label.intent: Confirm the TWAP runtime row is rendered

assert-twap-runtime-info.intent: Prove the Figma info affordance on the Runtime row exists (G4)

assert-twap-randomize.intent: Confirm the Randomize control from the Figma TWAP frame is present

set-twap-size.intent: Enter a size so the TWAP summary section renders populated rows

assert-twap-summary-runtime.intent: Prove the Figma Runtime summary row exists for TWAP (G3)

assert-twap-summary-size-per-suborder.intent: Prove the Figma Size per suborder summary row exists for TWAP (G3)

assert-twap-summary-hides-liquidation.intent: Prove Est Liquidation is dropped for TWAP as in the Figma summary frame

assert-twap-summary-hides-slippage.intent: Prove Slippage is dropped for TWAP as in the Figma summary frame

capture-twap.label: TWAP order form showing Runtime with its info affordance and Randomize
capture-twap.intent: Show the TWAP order panel a trader sees when choosing the order type

open-order-type-sheet-scale.intent: Reopen the order type chooser to switch to Scale

select-scale.intent: Switch the order form to the Scale order type

assert-scale-start.intent: Prove the Scale start field copy matches Figma

assert-scale-end.intent: Prove the Scale end field copy matches Figma

assert-scale-order-count.intent: Prove the Scale order count field copy matches Figma

assert-scale-size-skew.intent: Prove the Scale size skew field copy matches Figma

capture-scale.label: Scale order form showing Start, End, Order count and Size skew
capture-scale.intent: Show the Scale order panel a trader sees when choosing the order type

open-order-type-sheet-chase.intent: Reopen the order type chooser to switch to Chase

select-chase.intent: Switch the order form to the Chase order type

assert-chase-max-distance.intent: Prove the Chase max distance field copy matches Figma

capture-chase.label: Chase order form showing the reference price and Max distance (USD)
capture-chase.intent: Show the Chase order panel a trader sees when choosing the order type

scroll-twap-summary.intent: Bring the TWAP summary section into the visible area

capture-twap-summary.label: TWAP summary listing Runtime and Size per suborder, with no Est Liquidation or Slippage
capture-twap-summary.intent: Show the summary rows a trader reads before placing a TWAP order
